Third-party software in this folder
===================================

vendor/ol.js, vendor/ol.css
---------------------------
OpenLayers 10.11.0 - https://openlayers.org/ - BSD 2-Clause License
Copyright 2005-present, OpenLayers Contributors. The licence is in vendor/OPENLAYERS-LICENSE.md.

The two files are dist/ol.js (the full build) and ol.css of the npm package "ol", unchanged:
  https://registry.npmjs.org/ol/-/ol-10.11.0.tgz
  sha1    9f2505076569b438730996c1b6eedd48b0be6d88
  sha512  OJ+lrx7kx/1O7Xx18Ff9QkVnwZIEL0OuhJQSy2sYgzzDvyZ2qHvuZEGAajbSstUyBwaS1OtQ4RWnY84tRMDdqg== (base64)
  sha256 of vendor/ol.js   a4e607e98b56846d543e2131161720845c7a80170d5f00aa2bc8b6c4e0f9194a
  sha256 of vendor/ol.css  abc8afd72cc10bd29cc143f443bae4a6804bd3cb3fb262e6b6a6bc6c924ea34f
vendor/ol.js is byte for byte the file of the package: it keeps its last line
"//# sourceMappingURL=ol.js.map", although the source map (dist/ol.js.map, 5.6 MB) is not included, so
that the digest above can be checked against the package. A browser with its developer tools open may
ask for app/vendor/ol.js.map and get a 404: nothing else follows. The sources are those of the package
and of https://github.com/openlayers/openlayers (tag v10.11.0).

Libraries inside vendor/ol.js
-----------------------------
The full build of OpenLayers includes four libraries. They are the ones its source map lists outside
the sources of OpenLayers; the versions are those whose files are identical to the sources embedded in
that source map. Each licence file below is the LICENSE of the npm package, unchanged.

  rbush 4.0.1 - https://github.com/mourner/rbush - MIT License
    Copyright (c) 2024 Volodymyr Agafonkin
    licence: vendor/RBUSH-LICENSE.txt
    https://registry.npmjs.org/rbush/-/rbush-4.0.1.tgz
    sha256 a014b9d13d72b4cb657badb2961fc24429324b9db0dc1aa13f83d8dde81da410

  quickselect 3.0.0 - https://github.com/mourner/quickselect - ISC License
    Copyright (c) 2024, Vladimir Agafonkin
    licence: vendor/QUICKSELECT-LICENSE.txt
    https://registry.npmjs.org/quickselect/-/quickselect-3.0.0.tgz
    sha256 2cf90a3c6f9eb7ccb618bc31e362a615f9f46de593b8465176d883e66b5f8c84

  earcut 3.2.4 - https://github.com/mapbox/earcut - ISC License
    Copyright (c) 2026, Mapbox
    licence: vendor/EARCUT-LICENSE.txt
    https://registry.npmjs.org/earcut/-/earcut-3.2.4.tgz
    sha256 2f63624cc056e4f2f8109a84d10fff3daeea37581af14af0f612ff387cc2534a

  pbf 5.1.2 - https://github.com/mapbox/pbf - BSD 3-Clause License
    Copyright (c) 2026, Mapbox
    licence: vendor/PBF-LICENSE.txt
    https://registry.npmjs.org/pbf/-/pbf-5.1.2.tgz
    sha256 3b3dc3c096a3a264ae68722d1e380893d89d56161093f8e90b1910020fbdb5d7

The other dependencies of the package "ol" (geotiff, zarrita) are not in the full build and are not in
this folder.

Everything else in this folder (main.js, cog.js, i18n.js, style.css) is part of pyarchinit-photogrammetry,
GPL-2.0-or-later.
